settings.heading: 98% natural origin, and we show our math.
settings.text: Natural is a word anyone can print on a label. We back it with an international standard that scores each formula, and we list the numbers on the product page.

settings.heading: Three reasons we keep it short

settings.title: Skin is not a trash can
settings.text: What touches you daily should be something you can describe in plain words.

settings.title: Short lists, strong bars
settings.text: Fewer fillers mean more room for oils that clean and condition.

settings.title: Honest labels
settings.text: Every wrapper lists everything, in order, and no mystery buckets.

settings.heading: Twelve things we will not use.
settings.text: Each entry says what the ingredient does, where it usually hides and why we leave it out.
settings.detail_text: Common in antiperspirants, where they block sweat glands. We make deodorant instead: it handles odor without blocking anything.

settings.label: What does 98% natural origin mean?
settings.text: It is a score under an international standard that measures how much of a formula comes from plants, minerals or other natural sources.

settings.label: Is natural always gentler?
settings.text: Not automatically. That is why we test each formula on real skin and publish the no-go list alongside the scores.

settings.label: Where can I read a full ingredient list?
settings.text: On every product page, under the ingredients tab, and on the wrapper.
